title: Close-neighbour hashing and bounded approximate retrieval
summary: dev8 adds significance-preserving ordered hashes and multi-probe neighbour lookup: the largest weighted quantised discrepancy dominates hash distance, small bin changes remain close, and good-enough retrieval quality is measured against an exact oracle.
authority: Executable dev8 source/tests are authoritative. The design generalises the audio-landmark near-bucket requirement without making Audio own a private neighbour-search framework.
invariants: Close hashes are distance-bearing ordered coordinates, not cryptographic digests and not collision-probability-only LSH.
Hash difference is dominated by the largest weighted coordinate discrepancy, then the next largest; one serious mismatch cannot be hidden by many tiny agreements.
Adjacent quantisation cells remain adjacent even across conventional binary carry boundaries; do not infer closeness from packed-binary integer subtraction.
Exact-bucket lookup is radius 0. Tolerance is expressed as bounded query-side multi-probe over neighbouring cells rather than duplicating tolerant variants into the source index.
Probe-bucket and candidate budgets are explicit. Oversized probe requests fail closed rather than silently truncating an arbitrary subset.
Out-of-domain values fail by default. CLAMP must be explicit schema policy.
Approximate quality is evidence: compare against MLExactNeighbourIndex and report recall@k plus candidate fraction examined.
MLCloseNeighbourIndex is an MLDriveableObject; alternative schemas/resolutions/probe policies should be retained as historical branches rather than overwriting the only index state.
procedure: Declare one MLCloseHashDimension per ordered numeric feature: range, bin count, significance weight and range policy.
Build MLCloseHashSchema and fit MLCloseNeighbourIndex from an MLDataset with stable unique sample ids.
Choose MLCloseNeighbourPolicy with k, probe radius, candidate cap, HASH or exact-Euclidean rerank mode, and max probe buckets.
Use radius 0 for exact bucket semantics; increase radius only as needed for recall.
Qualify the chosen policy with MLCloseNeighbourAssessment against the exact oracle on representative evidence.

For audio landmark/fingerprint matching, keep the persisted exact 6+6+6-style coordinate index and use neighbouring-bucket probes for one-bin/tolerance recovery rather than exploding the source index.
Branch and compare schema/weight/radius alternatives using historical-object semantics when tuning good-enough retrieval.

provenance.claim: Executable ordered-hash, multi-probe index, exact oracle and assessment contracts.
Regression proving adjacent bins remain close across binary carry boundaries.
